svg.aria-label: Architecture of the care platform. Customers, a contact centre and staff on the left reach the API and the staff desk. Both write to one PostgreSQL database in the middle of the care platform, which runs in the cloud. The orchestrator with its five specialist agents reads SkyLink's systems through a gateway with read-only keys and asks a language model provider outside the platform. The feed consumer receives numbered events from Network Monitoring. The executor is the only writer. A human gate stands before a credit above INR 500. SkyLink's six systems are on-premises behind one API gateway.
